Regression from the E4 change (a ticket's own specs run before review) in tools/scope-commands.mjs around line 1403 to 1416 (runSpec and the spec loop in sync). In a project with no way to run a spec (no profile verify block and no package.json test script and no project checks that run it) runSpec returns failed with npm error Missing script test, which sends the ticket back and breaks tests/acceptance-sync.test.mjs (12 tests) and tests/batch-a-eval.test.mjs (eval 36.1 expects the old failure text: failed checks: tests; FAIL tests/T-0001.test.ts expected 201 got 500, from the verify block path). Keep the tests/scope-ownership and spec tests that cover E4 passing (their fixtures define a runner). Add a test in tests/scope-spec-gate.test.mjs or a new tests/scope-spec-no-runner.test.mjs: no runner means the ticket proceeds to the acceptance step; with a runner a failing spec still goes back.
